Data loading: Load three datasets from ../../../study/data: MovieLens100K (u.data), Amazon Video Games (VideoGames.csv), Hetrec LastFM (UserTaggedArtiststimestamps.dat). Apply 5-core filtering to all datasets.
Implicit conversion: For MovieLens100K and Amazon Video Games datasets, convert ratings > 3 to implicit interactions; Last.FM dataset remains implicit as provided.
Seeds: Use exactly five distinct random seeds: 12345, 23456, 34567, 45678, 56789.
Splitting: For each dataset/seed/algorithm perform a user-based 80/20 holdout split; ensure splits are reproducible via the seed.
Algorithms: Evaluate ALS, ItemKNN, and Pop using OmniRec exclusively; no direct LensKit/RecBole calls.
Hyperparameters: Use standard/default hyperparameters for ALS, ItemKNN, and Pop; apply the same defaults across all seeds; no hyperparameter tuning.
Metrics: Compute nDCG@k and Precision@k for k in {1,5,10} on the test set.
Training/evaluation: Train models on the training portion and evaluate on the test portion for every (dataset, algorithm, seed) combination.
Results aggregation: For each dataset and algorithm, compute mean and standard deviation of each metric across seeds for k in {1,5,10}.

Statistical analysis: Perform paired t-tests on per-seed metric values to compare algorithms within each dataset; report p-values and effect sizes; apply Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.

Plots: Generate plots showing mean metrics with error bars across seeds: (a) per dataset, and (b) within each dataset, lines for each algorithm across k values; produce separate plots for nDCG and Precision.
Outputs: Save results as CSV tables and plots (PNG/SVG) in a dedicated results directory; include a compact narrative summary file.
Directory layout: Place all outputs under a clearly named directory such as results/omni_rec/final_stage/ with subfolders for data, plots, logs, and metadata.
Reproducibility: Record seeds, splits, and hyperparameters; store a minimal metadata file describing the experiment setup.
OmniRec compliance: Ensure all recommender-system functionality is implemented via OmniRec; avoid direct calls to LensKit/RecBole code.
Documentation: Provide a README describing dataset-specific preprocessing steps and how to reproduce the experiment.
